name: Loan Offer
description: LOS-side, UI-facing mirror of an OCEN offer (ADR 0005) — just enough fields to drive the borrower's offer-comparison screen (spec §5.3 'N lenders offered you a loan'). The OCEN site owns the full protocol-level record (OCEN Offer: raw payloads, requestId correlation, etc.); this is a read view built from what los_engine.api.ocen_integration.receive_ocen_offer() is told, not a Link across the site boundary.

fields.label: OCEN Offer ID
fields.description: The OCEN site's OCEN Offer document name — a plain string reference, not a Link, per ADR 0005.

fields.label: Tenant
fields.description: Mirrored from the linked Loan Application at creation time. Needed directly on this doctype (not just via loan_application) because Frappe's User Permission row-level restriction only cascades through a doctype's own direct Link fields — see spec §3.2B, §4.2.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Received
Presented to Borrower
Accepted
Rejected
Expired
